name: Prestige Elm Park
overview: Prestige Elm Park is a residential development in Whitefield offering 3 and 4 bedroom homes across multiple towers, close to major IT parks, malls, hospitals and schools, with proximity to the Kadugodi, Whitefield and ITPL metro stations on the Purple Line extension.
highlights: Located in Whitefield with direct access to ITPL and the metro Purple Line extension
Multiple towers with 3 Bed, 3 Bed + Maid's and 4 Bed + Maid's layouts
Clubhouse with swimming pool and kids pool
Multipurpose 5-a-side football, tennis and half basketball court
Japanese contemplative garden and amphitheatre with stage
Skating rink, senior citizen corner and outdoor gymnasium
Part of Prestige's established Whitefield portfolio alongside Lakeside Habitat, Shantiniketan and White Meadows
amenities: Multipurpose 5-a-side football, tennis & half basketball court

items: RCC structure, cement blocks for walls
Elegant lobby flooring on ground floor; vitrified tiles in basement and upper floor lobbies
Lift cladding in marble/granite as per architect's design
Vitrified tiles in foyer, living, dining, corridors and all bedrooms
Ceramic tiles in balcony
Ceramic tiles in kitchen, utility, maid's room and maid's toilet
Tile dado 600mm above counter height along designated counter length
Provision for exhaust fan
Vitrified tiles for flooring and walls up to false ceiling
Counter-top wash basins; wall-hung EWCs
Master toilet with shower partition and glass door
Geysers in all toilets except the last two floors (solar water on last two floors)
Main door: timber frame and flush shutters
Internal doors: timber frame, laminated flush shutters
External doors/windows: UPVC/aluminium frames with clear glass
Concealed PVC-insulated copper wiring with modular switches
TV points in living and all bedrooms
ELCB and individual meters for all apartments
Security cabins at all entrances/exits with CCTV coverage
Generator for common areas; 100% apartment backup at additional cost
